items.text: What a buyer will find in your 2026 numbers, and how to find it first. For owners, and the certified public accountants who prepare their numbers. Everyone who reserves a seat receives the playbook.

A buyer in 2027 will read the year you are closing now. In a published study of seventy-five letters of intent that were signed and then collapsed, the reported reason in 21.3% was that the earnings were not what was presented. This session shows owners, and the certified public accountants who prepare their numbers, where a buyer looks.
Which add-backs and adjustments to earnings a buyer questions first
What is worth addressing before you go to market

Supported means an adjustment has the records and the calculation a reviewer can trace. Unsupported means the documents or the explanation are incomplete. Documentation does not mean a buyer has accepted the adjustment.
